title: P04 — Share effect mounting between player and renderer
description:
## Dispatch packet P04
Read initiative videoml-dbc2b1 sections D02 before editing. Those are binding decisions, not suggestions.

## Repositories and edit scope
stdlib, player, toolchain
Primary paths: stdlib/src/effects; player/src/runtime.ts; renderer browser mounting. Read repository AGENTS before any edits. Do not edit unrelated product code.

## Procedure
1. Read prerequisites and existing implementation at the paths above.
2. Add failing behavioral fixtures for the listed acceptance cases.
3. Implement registry/lifecycle contract and player seek/pause/dispose. Mount identical effect code in preview and capture. Preserve React component compatibility through adapter.
4. Run scoped checks plus required repo quality gates. Save actual commands, exit status and artifacts in an issue comment.
5. Return the diff and evidence to the primary reviewer; do not close the issue yourself.

## Acceptance
DOM and canvas fixtures seek correctly, assets settle, cleanup removes handlers/textures, conformance passes.

## Dependencies
videoml-d42794 (P03)

## Stop conditions
Do not guess a missing credential/account identity, bypass a failed test, substitute mocked evidence for a real smoke run, expand product scope, or change contract defaults. Report a precise blocker and return to the primary reviewer. A passing build alone is insufficient for rendering behavior.
